# Factorize

> Automate coding-agent jobs from provider events on your own exe.dev VM.

- [Quickstart](/quickstart): Configure Factorize and create a first job.
- [Concepts](/concepts): Jobs, triggers, runs, and the Mustache prompt contract.
- [REST authentication](/api/authentication): OAuth, scopes, and device authorization.
- [REST reference](/api/reference): Using the generated API reference.
- [OpenAPI contract](/openapi.yaml): Verified operation inventory, validation, scopes, and response schemas.
- [MCP](/mcp/overview): Connect a remote MCP client.
- [MCP tools](/mcp/tools): Complete tool catalog.
